_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractor's Progress, Status and Management Report
summary: The Contractor's Progress, Status and Management Report provides a detailed description of all flight activities planned and executed for the applicable calendar month.
use_relationship:
The Contractor's Progress, Status and Management Report provides a detailed description of all the flight activities planned and executed for the applicable calendar month.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID contains the format, content and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Progress Report content shall include the following:

children.title: Header Information.
children.content: Contractor Name, Address, Contract Number, Date of Report, Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) number and Classification.

children.title: Section 1: CLIN Summary shall include
children.content:
Contract Line Item Number (CLIN)
Description
Unit of Issue
Unit Price
Minutes Authorized
Minutes Funded
Minutes Unfunded
Minutes Invoiced
Minutes Unbilled
Dollars Authorized
Dollars Funded
Dollars Invoiced
Dollars Unbilled

children.title: Section 2: Delivery Order Summary shall include
children.content:
Delivery Order Number
Customer
Contract Line Item Number (CLIN)
Minutes Funded
Minutes Expended
Minutes Unbilled
Dollars Funded
Dollars Invoiced
Dollars Unbilled
Percent Billed (expanded to two decimals)
Funding Totals
Total

children.title: Section 3: Completed detachments reported by Scheduling Office (East Coast, West Coast, Mid/Westpac and 5.1.2 Special Programs)
children.content:
Start Date
End Date
Type/Service
Number of Minutes Flown
Number of Hours Flown
Number of Sorties

children.title: Section 4: Scheduled detachments reported by Scheduling Office (East Coast, West Coast, Mid/WestPac and 5.1.2 Special Programs)
children.content:
Start Date
End Date
Type/Service
Number of Minutes Flown
Number of Hours Flown
Number of Sorties
